gaps.explanation: Pass 5 (re-trim): trimmed pp17-24, 39, 42-48, 50-51 are the nonmajor combining statements. Added one line per printed non-zero row of each individual fund column that had no detail lines: Special revenue p19 Public Library Contribution (736,152), p20 Miscellaneous Contributions (5,532,023); capital projects pp42-47 (20,498,559 = p47 Total Capital Projects); permanent p48 Endowment for Library (3,086). Funds skipped because they already have detail lines (budget schedules): Judgment, Library Fines and Fees (detail 'Library Fine and Fees Fund'), Douglas County Library Supplement, Keno/Lottery Proceeds, Storm Water Fee Revenue, Interceptor Sewer Construction, Community Park Development, State Turn Back Revenue, Ballpark Revenue, Keno Lottery Reserve, Greater Omaha Convention and Visitors Center (detail 'Greater Omaha Convention and Visitors Bureau Fund'), Destination Marketing Corporation, Household Chemical Disposal, Development Revenue, Riverfront Redevelopment Special Tax (nonmajor debt service fund, p39), Western Heritage (permanent, p48) = 16 funds. Airport Business Park Development (p43) prints no non-zero row. Nonmajor enterprise funds pp50-51 (Tranquility Park, City Wide Sports Revenue, Marinas, Tennis Operations, Golf Operations, Air Quality, Printing Services and Graphics, Riverfront Plaza, Levi Carter Park): NOT added, detail already holds the combined 'Nonmajor Enterprise Funds' column from the proprietary statement (pass 2); adding the individual funds would double count. The p17-18 summary group columns (Special Revenue / Debt Service / Capital Projects / Permanent Funds) are subtotal columns and are not used.
